o: Huh? What?
The lottery grand prize?
What kind of partner?
I'm good at a lot of things, so just name it.
If it's being squeezed together in a tight space just the two of us, I'm confident.

chat.t: That's not the kind of stakeout I mean.
We'll talk details when we meet.

o: Oh, that's quite a hefty amount.

chat.t: Use that money to buy some nice clothes.
You shouldn't let others look down on you.

lines.t: Cafe Terrace
Why did she ask to meet in such an open place when she said we were going on a stakeout?
You're already here.
All in order to become your partner.
By the way, what were the criteria for choosing me?
The person who replied the fastest.
That's it?
Because it requires quick reflexes.
Isn't it less about quick reflexes and more about a battle of who stares at their Quartz the most?
Partner deal is canceled.
No way, that's not fair! I even gave up my work to come here!
Hmm... Doesn't looking at your Quartz all the time mean you don't actually have work?
That IS my work.
Right. I'll believe you.
Well, goodbye then.
Wait a minute!
Swoosh!
Eep...
Good, you do have some reflexes.
What if I got hit!
I would've just filed it under travel expenses.
I could even compensate you for the time you'd spend resting from injuries.
Ah, maybe I should've just let myself get hit...
Anyway, it seems your reflexes are decent.
Now, let's talk business.
Out in the open like this?
A place like this actually draws less suspicion.
Go order any drink you want.
You're paying, right?
Yes.
I ordered a drink and a bunch of desserts I wanted to eat.
Have you been starving for days?
I might starve for the next few days, so I have to eat and store up when I can.
Hmm...  Okay. Listen while you eat.
We're going to infiltrate a ball.
So the setup is that you and I are in a relationship?
No. Boss and subordinate.
For the record, I'm the boss. Because I'm paying.
A subordinate with eyes on the boss...  That's not exactly an unpopular setup.
I don't know what you're trying to get at, but...
So, how about the pay?
Oh, right. The contract...
I'll bring it next time we meet.
You can't do that!
Send it via MochiTalk!
Got it.
Next time, wear some nice clothes.
I don't have money.
Oh, right. The advance...
Why do you keep forgetting everything!
I'll send it to your account.
So when is the infiltration?
In five hours.
That's <bouten>tonight</bouten>!!!
First, I'm off to buy clothes!
Send the contract and advance payment right now!

chat.t: Did you manage to buy the clothes?

o: Got myself fitted with a top-of-the-line suit.
But it feels a bit unfamiliar.

chat.t: Go run a lap around the park or something.

o: If I do that, I'll smell like sweat!

chat.t: You look cleaner than I expected.

o: First impressions are important!
Okay.
Let me read it.

chat.t: Reading it at the ball will draw attention.

o: Got it, I'll head to the restroom.

chat.t: Why of all places the restroom?

o: Because I can focus well.
Because it's quiet.

chat.t: Hmm... Then I'll keep an eye on the target.

o: Don't get distracted watching butterflies.

lines.t: Cafe Terrace
Butterfly...
Why are you chasing a butterfly?
You're here? You look really sharp.
Of course I am.
*Sniff* *sniff*... Did you put on cologne too?
I tried styling myself to stimulate all five senses. Is it bad?
No, it's good. That should hold up anywhere.
What about how I looked earlier?
Probably enough to make people pity you and give you money.
Was it that bad? Don't tell me that's why the advance payment was so high?
That's the amount specified in the contract. It has nothing to do with my feelings.
Well, shall we head to the ball now?
Here, your hand.
Hmm...?
If we're partners, we should hold hands nicely.
If that makes it easier to infiltrate.
Pleased to work with you, partner.
Just call me Shizuku.
Okay.
Ballroom
We made it inside safely.
Of course. That's what the attire was for.
Wow, it's so luxurious inside.
Don't look around so much. It'll raise suspicion.
Act as natural as possible.
Can I just keep my eyes on you, then?
Hmm... That would actually be for the best.
Okay, permission granted!
But your gaze seems to be dropping a little?
What are you looking at?
It's a secret.
Anyway, from now on is what's important.
You said it's an infiltration, so what am I supposed to do?
It's simple. See that person wearing the dress over there?
Yeah, the cat beastkin wearing the expensive-looking clothes.
Now, you just need to  eliminate them.
What? Do what to them?
Eliminate them.
Who?
You.
Then that's not infiltration, it's assassination!
Hmm... Is it?
Aren't they similar in that you slip in secretly to do the job?
From that perspective they might be similar, but the ending is completely different!
Impossible?
Of course.  My combat ability is literally zero.
You dodged pretty well earlier...
That was survival instinct.
Hmm...  Then there was no point in bringing you along.
I was planning to have you handle them while I cleaned up the aftermath.
Mission failure just like this...?
I have a good idea.
I lure them outside. You deal with them.
That way, there's no need to clean up anything here, right?
Good. I'll leave it to you.
Then send me some info on the target.
Why do you need that?
I need a conversation topic to approach them.
...Alright. I'll send you the relevant files.

o: Humanitas Businesswoman
Teaming up with the mafia to bulldoze the DD TOWN shopping district...

chat.t: That part is classified, so if you mention it, you'll raise suspicion.
They're already on high alert because of that.
There are many small businesses in the DD TOWN shopping district that various companies invest in.

o: So that's why they're targeting them.
Then, is there another useful topic...?
Supporting adult film production in Vermont as a charitable endeavor...?

chat.t: It seems their hobby is watching adult films.

o: Great. This topic will work perfectly.

chat.t: The target is alone just now.

o: Okay, I'll go right now.

chat.t: Keep today's matter a secret to the grave.

o: Well, of course.
More importantly, what happened to the target?

chat.t: After doing OO to make them XX, I did OOO and am now making them XX.
They're whimpering and crying out like crazy.

o: I kind of want to see that too?
That's a shame.

lines.t: Ballroom
Where's the target?
Over there.
Shall we go together, then?
Me too?
I absolutely need you.
Well, if you say so...
Hello there, beautiful lady.
Yes? Can I help you?
Actually, I'm producing a special film in Vermont...
I'm here to introduce the lead actress of our latest film.
Oh, is it this person?
She's quite lovely.
Wasn't I the boss...?
Just play along.
Hmm...  Hello.
Oh my, how cute. So, what kind of film is it?
It's a film called "The Lovely Cat Doesn't Cry Out."
That name sounds incredibly hardcore.
We're targeting a niche audience.
What do you think? Might you be interested?
No, I'm not interested.
Failed...
No, it's a success.
Why?
Because she walked outside, didn't she?
People can never admit to such hardcore hobbies in public places, after all.
Let's follow her.
Why on earth are you following me? How rude.
There's no one here to overhear us, is there?
Why don't you comfortably speak your mind?
You're quite quick-witted indeed.
Phew...
Where did that actress go!
What exactly happens to her?!
Ah... A lovely kitten like that, unable to cry out...
In that case, we must torment her until she cries out!!
Surely there's a scene where she's made to OO and then XX, and then OOO to make her XX?
Ah! You are an absolute genius.
I want to watch that film right now!
I'll give you as much money as you want!  No, actually, I'll distribute it exclusively!
Mmh... So that's her taste.
Didn't you say we were going to eliminate her?
I changed my mind.
Because now I want to make her cry out.
